name: SAP SE (via US ADR)
verdict: OWNABLE — 1.0% starter (the DD's 5% cap REJECTED); add to 2.5% ONLY on the compound Jul-23 gate; hard cap 3.0%
entry_band: 1.0% starter (ADR, marketable limit); ADD to 2.5% only if Jul-23 passes the COMPOUND gate: cc-CCB >=24% AND all three FY26 guides reaffirmed (cloud rev, op profit, FCF) AND no disclosure widening the seat-repricing cohort. the 22-23.9% zone = HOLD starter, no add (thesis weakening)
H2 FCF guide slippage on AI-hardware costs (the Goldman channel)

court_record.dd: 7/10: real-but-over-de-rated; CCB 27->25->25; CEO concedes the seat mechanism; ECC-migration floor; proposed 5% cap + FV $196
court_record.red_team_fable: APPROVE-MODIFIED: (1) THE 5% CAP REJECTED on taxonomy — a valuation-class edge gates PRICE never size; 2x standard max on an uncalibrated edge with a CEO-conceded bear mechanism and a binary in 18 days has no conviction math -> 1%/2.5%/3%; (2) revenue-neutrality UNVERIFIABLE — no seats-to-AI-Units bridge exists anywhere; the steel-man (20-30% of EUR16-19bn seat ARR through the 2027-29 renewal wall) = 4-7pp/yr cloud headwind -> FV blended $178 (65% reaffirm-path 196 / 35% repricing-path 145); CCB LAGS the mechanism (smaller renewals book at renewal; consumption contracts mechanically book LOWER committed backlog even in success); (3) the January slowdown DEFUSED — backlog timing (sovereign-SaaS + large-deal ramps), revenue held, 27->25->25 verified; (4) the ECC floor real but THIN (revenue-weighting undisclosed; extended maintenance to 2030 at +9%; Rimini leakage); (5) buyback = PROGRAMMATIC (EUR5bn/yr pace regardless of price, partly bond-funded) — the 'value signal' struck; (6) FCF: Q1 included a EUR408M Teradata settlement — ex-item flat; the EUR10bn guide needs +45% H2 vs LY = the tripwire Goldman is cutting; (7) THE GATE REWRITTEN — the DD's >=22% add-bar tolerated prints that falsify its own 'held' thesis (a 22 print = a NEW 3-point step-down); compound gate installed.
court_record.adjudication: accepted in full — the gate-falsification catch is the court's finest logic bug this week

catalyst_overlays.call: WAIVED — undated; watch the Jul-23 call for disclosure
WAIVED — second-order to the print gate

edge_explainer.market_believes: AI agents will eat seat-based software, and SAP's CEO just agreed — halve the multiple.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The fear is real but over-charged: the backlog is contracted through the window the market is panicking about, the repricing lands at the 2027-29 renewal wall not tomorrow, and 16x cash flow already pays for a bad transition — but the honest fair value is $178, not the bull's $196, and the position is sized for a conceded mechanism, not against it.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Patience with a lagging indicator: everyone reads the same backlog number; the discipline is knowing it CAN'T confirm the bear yet — and gating adds on the compound print instead of the single number.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: A 35% repricing-path probability is our own number — the de-rate may simply be early and right.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Jul-23 (CONFIRMED) compound gate; the 2027 renewal-cohort disclosures; H2 FCF vs the hardware-cost channel.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: CCB <22%, any guide cut, or NRR degradation = the repricing is arriving faster than contracted — exit.
edge_explainer.edge_type: 1% starter, court-cut sizing; order decision on the user's desk
